category_title: Medium-proficiency students who struggle with run-on sentences and L1/L2 translation issues
scenario_title: Revising drafts of a Personal Narrative assignment
minimal_context: The student is working individually in the classroom to revise the second draft of their Personal Narrative assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take out the second draft of your Personal Narrative assignment so we can work on revising it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I looked at it, but after the revision of my second draft, I found more errors and they were the same. Like before, those were mostly the run-on and repeated sentences.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, let's just try to correct those sentences now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It is difficult for me to correct my essay. I understand how hard to organize thoughts and choose the correct words. I'm from Korea, and there they don't teach how to organize thoughts and write an essay.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best to write what you mean.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Because of the problems with use of English language, I lost confidence in writing. I found it hard because there were errors in almost all my essay. Since I am not a good talker, I had troubles with expressing my thoughts in a proper way.
